exceptions.mitigation: Cortex does not process user-supplied Less and never starts the Vitest API server in production or CI. Recheck upstream monthly.

exceptions.reason: The patched Parcel reporter requires Parcel 2.16 while Plasmo 0.90.5 pins Parcel 2.9; forcing it makes the build invalid.
exceptions.mitigation: Release and CI only run the one-shot Plasmo build and never expose its development server. Track a compatible Plasmo upgrade.

exceptions.reason: The advisory has no patched release and affects generated browser bundles only when attacker-controlled import metadata is built.
exceptions.mitigation: Only reviewed repository source enters the release build; no remote or user-authored modules are compiled by the packaged app.

exceptions.reason: Svelte is a dormant Plasmo transformer dependency; Cortex is React-only and performs no Svelte server-side rendering.
exceptions.mitigation: No .svelte source exists in the extension and the release artifact contains no Svelte runtime. Track a compatible Plasmo upgrade.
